request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Which categories of Annex I, Part A of the Regulation were not in Annex IV of Directive 2006/42/EC?

response.text: {"kind": "set", "value": ["Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions (Annex I, Part A, point 5)", "Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems (Annex I, Part A, point 6)"], "text": "Two categories in Annex I, Part A of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (REG.md) have no counterpart in Annex IV of Directive 2006/42/EC (DIR.md): points 5 and 6, both concerning self-evolving machine-learning safety functions. The other four Part A categories (points 1–4: removable transmission devices and their guards, vehicle servicing lifts, portable cartridge-operated fixing machinery) do appear in Annex IV of the Directive as points 14–16 and 18.", "sources": [{"file": "REG.md", "place": "Annex I, Part A, point 5", "quote": "5. Safety components with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Annex I, Part A, point 6", "quote": "6. Machinery that has embedded systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions that have not been placed independently on the market, in respect only of those systems."}, {"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Annex IV", "quote": "14. Removable mechanical transmission devices including their guards. 15. Guards for removable mechanical transmission devices. 16. Vehicle servicing lifts. 17. Devices for the lifting of persons or of persons and goods involving a hazard of falling from a vertical height of more than three metres. 18. Portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery."}]}
